decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The window formed in the dormer window of the side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the side dormer window elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured.
(Reason.  To prevent overlooking of the nearby premises in accordance with policy ENV.B.1.1 New development.)
description: Erection of single storey rear extension and roof extensions to dwellinghouse.
